name: NextEra Energy
description: NextEra is two different businesses under one name. Florida Power & Light (FPL) is a regulated monopoly utility with more than 6 million customer accounts and about 36,600 MW of generating capacity; the Florida commission sets its rates, and it earns an allowed return on the plant it builds. NextEra Energy Resources (NEER) builds wind, solar, battery and gas projects and sells the output under long-term contracts; it had about 35.1 GW of renewable and storage projects in backlog at Q2 2026. FPL supplied about 63 percent of segment profit on 67 percent of revenue; NEER's reported profit is helped by tax credits and by outside investors absorbing project losses ($1.5B added back in 2025). On May 18, 2026 NextEra agreed to acquire Dominion Energy in an all-stock deal. Most of the story is capital spending: $24.6B invested in 2025.

employees.note: Approximately 17,400 across NEE and subsidiaries; FPL approximately 9,400 (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Florida Power & Light (FPL)
businessLines.how: Customers pay regulated rates set by the Florida Public Service Commission that cover fuel, operating costs and an allowed return on invested plant; profit grows as the plant base grows through approved investment and as customers are added (over 90,000 added in Q2 2026).
businessLines.description: Regulated electric utility serving about 12 million people in Florida.

operatingProfit.label: Segment net income attributable to NEE (the segment profit measure reported; not operating income)

businessLines.name: NextEra Energy Resources (NEER)
businessLines.how: Sells electricity and renewable attributes from projects it builds under long-term contracts (power purchase agreements) to utilities and corporations, plus gas infrastructure, trading and storage; profit relies on tax credits and on selling stakes in projects to investors.
businessLines.description: Competitive developer and operator of contracted renewable, storage, nuclear and gas generation across the US.

operatingProfit.label: Segment net income attributable to NEE; includes $1,503M net loss attributable to noncontrolling interests and a $1,140M income tax benefit

businessLines.name: Corporate and Other
businessLines.how: Not a revenue engine: holds corporate interest and other costs.
businessLines.description: Non-utility corporate items and smaller businesses.

operatingProfit.label: Net loss attributable to NEE from Corporate and Other

brands.note: Has a service agreement with NEE subsidiaries (Q2 2026 10-Q); details not extracted
